record.name: Recap — AI Sales Coach
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Recap is the AI that coaches you after every sales meeting.

Most tools give you a transcript and a to-do list. Recap tells you what actually happened in the deal: what went well, what got risky, and exactly what to do next — moments after you hang up.

JUST HIT RECORD
Simple, private capture on your iPhone. No meeting bots joining your calls, no busywork. When the meeting ends, Recap gets to work.

YOUR MEETING, SCORED IN SECONDS
• Meeting Score (0–10) with a comparison to your own average
• Talk ratio: how much you talked vs. your prospect, benchmarked against healthy discovery behavior
• Objections detected — price, authority, timing, fit, trust — each with the exact phrase, the underlying concern, and a suggested response
• BANT and MEDDIC coverage, measured automatically
• Deal risk: green, amber, or red, with one clear reason

ONE CLEAR NEXT MOVE
After every call, Recap gives you one specific recommendation — not a wall of notes. Coaching cards point at the thing most likely to move the deal: a missing question, a mishandled objection, a buying signal you can still act on, or follow-up timing.

FOLLOW-UP, HANDLED
• AI-drafted follow-up email based on what was actually said
• Push notes, next steps, and deal stage straight to HubSpot CRM
• Every follow-up logged the moment your call ends

SEE EVERY DEAL EVOLVE
Recap remembers your deals across meetings. Deal History shows how each opportunity has changed call by call, surfaces recurring objections, and gives you a prep brief before your next conversation.

COACH YOUR WHOLE TEAM
On Recap Pro, create a workspace and invite your reps. The Team Dashboard shows average scores, common objections, talk-ratio outliers, and deals at risk — so you can coach with data, not gut feel.

WHO IT'S FOR
Account executives, SDRs, founders who sell, and sales managers who want every rep to get coaching after every call — not just the calls a manager happens to join.

FREE AND PRO
• Free: record meetings and get AI summaries with action items.
• Recap Pro (Monthly or Annual auto-renewable subscription): the full AI Sales Coach on every meeting — score cards, deal risk, objections, BANT coverage, coaching cards, follow-up email drafts, CRM push, personal deal history, and team workspaces. Current pricing is shown in the app before you subscribe.

New subscribers start with a 7-day free trial. The trial converts to a paid subscription at the price shown in the app unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.

Subscriptions are billed to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Your recordings are yours. Audio is processed to produce your transcript and coaching, and you can delete your account and data at any time.

The hardest part of sales is the call you haven't made yet. CoachCraft lets you practice it first - low-stakes reps with an AI buyer that shake off the anxiety before you ever dial a real prospect.

Pick a scenario, hit call, and have a real voice conversation with an AI persona that pushes back like a live prospect - skeptical CFOs, busy gatekeepers, price-shoppers, and more. Every call connects. Every call ends with an honest scorecard. No waiting, no "try again later."

- Speech metrics that catch your habits: talking pace (WPM) and filler words
- Sentence-level rewrites that turn "uh, well, I just wanted to..." into a clean line
- AI Coach insights that explain the why behind every note

- Get a full debrief: where you lost the room, what to say next time
- Turn live deals into your best practice material

SHOW UP READY FOR EVERY MEETING
- Connect your calendar and prep for upcoming meetings
- Walk in with the right questions and answers already rehearsed

- A skills radar across listening, empathy, clarity, objections, and negotiation
- Streaks, talk-time, and scores that show your arc over weeks
- Team leaderboards to push each other and stay sharp

- Sales managers can onboard and level up new reps faster
- Consistent practice and feedback across the whole floor

- Job seekers prepping for high-stakes interviews
- Anyone who gets nervous before an important conversation

There's nothing else like practicing the call before the call. Build the reps, build the confidence, and walk into every conversation like you've already had it.

Download CoachCraft and make your next call your best one.

record.name: Salesy: AI Sales Roleplay
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Salesy is AI sales training you do out loud. Call realistic AI prospects, handle their objections live, and get scored on every call before a real lead is on the line.

REAL-TIME AI VOICE ROLEPLAYS
Start a call and talk to an AI prospect in natural conversation. They interrupt you, push back on price and go cold when your discovery is weak. Earn their trust and they open up. Every prospect has their own personality, industry and reasons to say no, and new ones keep getting added.

30-SECOND OBJECTION SCENARIOS
One objection, one live voice, thirty seconds to handle it.

"Everything sounds good, but I want to think about it."
"It's too expensive."
"Just send me an email."

You get scored on how you handled it. Run the same scenario again and watch your score move. A full roleplay builds stamina. A scenario builds reflexes.

POST-CALL ANALYSIS
After every call you get a breakdown of how you sold, scored skill by skill, with the moments that moved the conversation and the one thing to fix before your next call.

REPLAYS
Every call you make is saved. Go back through any of them whenever you want, see the score again, and check whether the thing you were told to fix actually changed.

STATS OVER TIME
Your stats page shows how your selling changes call after call across every metric Salesy tracks. See where you are improving, spot where you are stuck, and get coaching suggestions on what to work on next.

COURSES
Short lessons on the skills that close deals, laid out as a path you work through step by step, with a quiz after each one.

LEADERBOARD
Compete with other salespeople on XP, achievements and close rate. See where you rank and what it takes to move up.

EVENTS AND EXCLUSIVE BADGES
Limited-time events give you badges you can only earn while the event is live. Once it ends, the badge is gone. Build your collection and show it off on your profile.

RANKS, XP, MISSIONS AND STREAKS
Every call and every lesson earns XP. Daily missions, achievements and streaks keep you practicing, and you climb from Rookie to Elite as your skills improve.

BUILT FOR iOS 26
The whole app is designed with Liquid Glass, so practicing feels as smooth as the rest of your iPhone.

WHO SALESY IS FOR
SDRs and BDRs sharpening cold calls and discovery. Account executives preparing for high-stakes pitches. Anyone selling on commission who wants more reps without burning real leads.

START TODAY
Download Salesy, run one scenario and get your score in under a minute.

record.description_evidence:
Your prospect raises an objection. What do you say next?

Close That Sale is the sales coach in your pocket — giving you practical responses, proven closing techniques and the confidence to handle difficult sales conversations when it matters most.

KNOW WHAT TO SAY NEXT

Enter the objection you're hearing — from “That's too expensive” to “I need to think about it” — and get practical responses you can use to keep the conversation moving.

Close That Sale doesn't just suggest what to say. It explains why the response works, helping you become a more capable and confident salesperson over time.

INSTANT OBJECTION COACHING

When you're confronted by a difficult objection, get immediate guidance designed to help you respond calmly and intelligently rather than guess what to say next.

A LIBRARY OF PROVEN RESPONSES & CLOSES

Explore an expert-curated library of common sales objections, responses and closing techniques organised by category. Favourite the approaches you want ready before your next sales conversation.

PRACTISE BEFORE THE PRESSURE IS REAL

Knowing the answer is one thing. Delivering it confidently is another.

Rehearse objections privately, practise your delivery and build confidence so the right response becomes easier to recall when you're speaking with a real prospect.

BUILD YOUR SALES CONFIDENCE

Record your sales outcomes and use the Confidence Meter, close-rate trends and win patterns to see how your performance develops over time.

BUILT FOR REAL-WORLD SALES

Close That Sale is designed for salespeople, business owners, account managers, business development professionals and anyone who regularly hears:

• “That's too expensive.”
• “I need to think about it.”
• “Send me some information.”
• “I need to speak to my boss.”
• “We don't have the budget.”
• “Now isn't the right time.”
• “Can you give me a discount?”
• “I'm not ready to make a decision.”

Don't let the next objection end the conversation.

Know what to say next.

CLOSE THAT SALE PRO

Everything you need to handle an objection is free: the full objection library and closing deck, unlimited searches, practice drills, your call log and your close-rate trend.

An optional Close That Sale Pro subscription adds:
• An unlimited cheat sheet — the free plan pins up to 10 lines
• Win correlations — which closes actually beat which objections, from your own logged calls
• Weekly goal projections — know mid-week whether you're on pace

Monthly: A$10.99
Annual: A$119.99
Includes a 14-day free trial where offered.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple account settings.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Reevo is the AI-native Sales Platform for sales teams. It runs your whole sales motion in one place: prospecting, outreach, meetings, CRM, pipeline, coaching insights, and reporting. 

Integrate the tools you already use, or run everything on Reevo. The CRM updates itself, and the full story of every deal stays with the deal, not buried in someone's inbox. Reevo learns what wins and puts it to use everywhere: drafted follow-ups, clean records, early risk flags.

The Reevo mobile app puts that platform in your pocket. Ask about any deal, record meetings without a bot, scan a badge into your CRM, and update deals before you're back at your desk. Everything you capture is visible to the team the moment it lands, so pricing, a security review, or a specialist can follow up before you’re back at your desk.

A Reevo account is required. New to Reevo? Visit reevo.ai to see the platform and talk to sales.

ASK REEVO, ANYWHERE
Talk or type. Ask about pipeline, deal health, objections, or next steps. Reevo reasons across every call, email, and record your team has, and cites the exact source behind every answer.
- "What's the latest with Acme?"
- "Draft the follow-up from this morning's call"
- "Which deals need attention this week?"

RECORD THE MEETING. NO BOT.
One tap records in-person meetings and phone calls. Take structured notes while you record; your notepad and recorder are one screen. Get AI summaries with key outcomes, action items, and open questions, plus full transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps.

SNAP A BADGE, GET A CONTACT
Scan a badge or business card and Reevo creates the contact, enriches it, and files it to the right account. Built for conference floors and field days.

MEETING PREP, DONE IN THE ELEVATOR
See your day with full context: participants, linked accounts, deal history, and AI talking points for every call. The deal, the people, the open items.

UPDATE THE DEAL ON THE SPOT
Change stage, amount, and next steps from your phone. No "I'll log it when I'm back at my laptop."

YOUR TEAM SEES IT LIVE
Everything you capture on mobile lands in the deal record right away. Follow-ups start before you're back at your desk, and the next person picks up right where the deal left off.

THE AI-NATIVE SALES PLATFORM, IN YOUR POCKET
On desktop, Reevo covers the full cycle: Find (prospecting and enrichment), Connect (sequences and outreach), Sell (meeting intelligence and deal execution), and Manage (pipeline, forecasting, coaching). The mobile app keeps all of it current from wherever the selling happens.

Questions or feedback? Reach us at support@reevo.ai.

record.description_evidence:
Paragon turns every sales call into data you can actually use.

Record live or upload after the conversation. We transcribe it, score it across six rep-defining pillars, and hand back a personalized coaching plan in 30 to 90 seconds. No managers reviewing tape. No CRM busywork. Just the signal you've been missing.

THE SIX PILLARS
Every call gets a 0–100 score across the moves that decide whether you win:
• Clarity — how clean and crisp your message lands
• Influence — your ability to move the conversation
• Discovery — the questions you ask, the pain you uncover
• Objection — how you handle pushback
• Delivery — pacing, fillers, energy, presence
• Close — momentum into next steps

YOUR PRIVATE PLAYBOOK
Paragon builds a coaching rubric from your industry, your ICP, and the way you actually pitch. Every call is scored against that rubric. The system learns what's working and what isn't, then drips back the exact moves you should double down on — and the habits to kill.

DRILL AND MISSION
Drill captures one pitch at a time. Mission records an entire day of back-to-back conversations — we detect each customer call automatically and score them individually. Five demos in, five separate scorecards out.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
Anonymous, global, season-based. Reps everywhere are getting better and you can see exactly where you stand. Streaks, rank shifts, and the kind of competition that pushes you forward.

WHO IT'S FOR
Outbound reps. Account executives. Founders running their own sales. Anyone who's ever wished they could replay a call and know — with numbers, not vibes — what to fix.

TRY IT FREE

record.description_evidence:
SELBUK CRM-AI puts your whole business in your pocket: customers, inventory, quotes, invoices, payments and field routes — all in one app that keeps working when the signal drops.

Built for distribution companies, wholesalers and growing businesses that sell on the road, at the counter and online.

SELL FROM ANYWHERE
• Build a quote or an invoice in three taps: pick the customer, pick the products, review and send.
• Price tiers A–E per customer, five discount modes and tax rules that follow your company settings.
• Send the PDF by email or WhatsApp, or print it on a Bluetooth thermal printer.
• Scan barcodes and QR codes with the camera to add products in seconds.

KNOW YOUR STOCK
• Real-time stock per product, with cost, movements and a full Kardex.
• Low-stock and ABC reports, inventory counts and short closes.
• Purchases and purchase returns, so what you buy and what you sell live in the same ledger.

GET PAID
• Collect against one invoice or spread a single payment across many.
• Receipts with their own numbering, exported as PDF.
• Receivables and aging: see who owes you, how much and since when.

YOUR TEAM IN THE FIELD
• Up to 50 users on one account: each sales rep with their own route, portfolio and customers.
• Routes and visits with GPS check-in, so you know a stop really happened.
• Activities and tasks assigned per sales rep.
• Roles and permissions: each person sees only what their role allows.

WORKS OFFLINE
• Everything is stored on the device and syncs when the connection comes back.
• Several accounts on the same phone, each with its own data and its own sign-in.
• Face ID, Touch ID or a PIN to get back in.

FOR YOUR CUSTOMERS
• A B2B portal where your customers place their own orders, see their statements and download their invoices.

ALSO ON THE WEB
Your data is the same one you see in the SELBUK web CRM: what you invoice on the phone is already on the desktop, and the other way around.

BILINGUAL
Full Spanish and English, switchable at any time.

ACCOUNTS
SELBUK CRM-AI works with your SELBUK account, and you can create one for free from the app itself. The app is free to download and use, and there is nothing to buy inside it.

SUPPORT
Questions, bugs or ideas: support102@selbuk.com — or use Support inside the app, which attaches your version and account details so nobody has to ask "which version do you have?".

Deallo - The AI Sales Agent Built for Reverse Logistics & Wholesale

Understand Buyer. Sell Faster.
Deallo is an AI-powered wholesale sales platform that learns from your communications, inventory, buyers, and invoices to match the right buyers to your stock, instantly. Built for liquidators, wholesalers, and reverse logistics teams, Deallo replaces messy spreadsheets, scattered inboxes, and gut-feel buyer matching with intelligent automation that actually closes deals.

----------------
WHY DEALLO
In reverse logistics and liquidation, every pallet is unique, every buyer has different preferences, and every hour of delay means inventory sitting in your warehouse. Traditional CRMs were not built for this. Deallo was.

Our AI Sales Agent understands what each buyer wants, what is in your inventory right now, and how to reach them through the channels that actually drive replies, including email and messaging apps.

----------------
KEY FEATURES
- CONTACTS - BUYER LIST
Manage your entire buyer network in one place. Track each buyer's purchase history, preferences, and sales memo records, so you always know who to reach out to first.

- COMMUNICATION - EMAIL
All buyer conversations are unified into a single inbox. Send and receive emails, and view your entire communication history with each buyer in one place.

- INVENTORY
Upload your inventory and organize every pallet, SKU, or truckload in one place. Track what is available and what has sold in real time.

- INVOICES
Generate, send, and track invoices without leaving the platform. Stay on top of open, paid, and overdue payments in one clear view.

- BUYER FORM - ADD NEW BUYER
Onboard new buyers instantly with a structured form that captures preferences, categories, and contact details.

- ASK DEALLO - AI SALES AGENT
Your on-demand AI sales agent. Enter any information that describes your inventory, and Ask Deallo will help you find the right buyers.

----------------
WHO IT'S FOR

- Liquidation wholesalers
- Reverse logistics providers
- Returns and overstock resellers
- Pallet and truckload brokers
- B2B wholesale sales teams
- Distributors managing large buyer networks

----------------
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH DEALLO

- Match new inventory to the right buyers in seconds
- Automate buyer follow-ups without sounding robotic
- Track every deal from first communication to closed sale
- Manage email and messaging conversations in one app
- Get AI-suggested next steps for every buyer
- Score and prioritize your buyer list automatically
- Send personalized outreach campaigns at scale
- Sync conversations across your sales team

----------------
BUILT FOR MOBILE SELLERS
Wholesale deals don't wait until you're back at your desk. Whether you're in your car, out of the office, or on the move, Deallo is built mobile-first so you can reply to buyers, close deals, and update inventory from anywhere.

----------------
SECURE & ENTERPRISE-READY
Your buyer relationships and deal data are protected with enterprise-grade security. Your data is yours.

----------------
Sell smarter. Move inventory faster. Close more deals.
Deallo - Understand Buyer, Sell Faster.

record.description_evidence:
Turn every real objection you hear into a drill you can't lose.

Ai Sales Roleplay Coach is built around one loop that actually changes how you sell: capture the objection a buyer really said to you, practice it against an adaptive AI buyer who rephrases it like a real person, get feedback tied to your exact words, and retry the one beat you missed.

CAPTURE REAL OBJECTIONS
• Log the exact wording, the context, and your 1-10 judgment of whether it's the buyer's real concern
• Record your hypothesis about what's actually behind it
• Start today with 50 researched starter objections (status quo, price skepticism, trust, brush-offs, authority, terms) - clearly badged, fully editable, meant to be replaced by your own field experience

PRACTICE AGAINST A BUYER WHO PUSHES BACK
• The AI buyer rephrases your objection naturally - never the same wording twice
• It hides the real concern and only opens up when you earn it
• Instant rebuttals are never rewarded: acknowledge and diagnose first, like the field demands
• Coaches the five behaviors: ACKNOWLEDGE, DIAGNOSE, RESPOND, CONFIRM, ADVANCE

FEEDBACK YOU CAN ACT ON
• One sales weakness and one delivery weakness per attempt - never a wall of notes
• Every point cites your actual transcript, with the quote and timestamp
• A focused retry drill rebuilt from your own weak sentence
• Spaced repetition brings each objection back at a harder tier as you improve

YOUR FACTS, NOT INVENTED ONES
• Attach your own approved product facts, with sources
• Spoken claims are graded supported, contradicted, or unverifiable against YOUR fact library
• The app never invents savings numbers, rates, or scripts for you to memorize

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Objections, facts, and practice history stay on your device
• Voice is transcribed on-device; raw audio is never uploaded
• Cloud roleplays send only the current scenario text to generate the buyer's replies - no accounts, no ads, no tracking

FREE AND PRO
• Free forever: capture, library, offline practice buyer, history, spaced repetition, plus 3 cloud AI roleplays to start
• Coach Pro: 30 adaptive cloud AI roleplays every month - $9.99/month or $49.99/year

Built for individual B2B sellers - field reps, walk-in sellers, closers - starting with merchant services and useful for any seller who hears the same objections every week.
